artifacts.name: PHWConsent
artifacts.title: PHW Consent
artifacts.description: A privacy consent directive held for, and shown to, the holder of a Personal Health Wallet: an IHE PCF 1.1.0 Intermediate Consent whose policy is set by a trust domain. Either explicit (PHWExplicitConsent) or implied (PHWImpliedConsent). Trust-anchor neutral: GDHCN is one possible trust anchor among others.

artifacts.name: PHWDocumentWithConsent
artifacts.title: IPS document that carries its consent directives
artifacts.description: An International Patient Summary document a Personal Health Wallet shares or an issuer issues, carrying the consent directives it is shared under, explicit or implied. Carrying them is optional (0..*); when they are carried, the Composition's Advance Directives section (LOINC 42348-3) lists them. The copy in the document is evidence for the receiver; the copy in the sharer's Consent Registry is the one enforced.

artifacts.name: PHWExplicitConsent
artifacts.title: PHW Explicit Consent
artifacts.description: A consent the holder gave by their own act: on the wallet, or on a form a health worker recorded (process L). Categorized with an HL7 ActConsentDirective code (OPTIN, OPTINR, OPTOUT or OPTOUTE). The act is the evidence (source[x]). When the trust domain publishes consent codes, policyRule names the code and the version of its text the holder was shown; otherwise policy.uri names the IHE PCF implicit policy the consent changes.

artifacts.name: PHWImpliedConsent
artifacts.title: PHW Implied Consent
artifacts.description: A consent the holder did not give by any act: categorized with an HL7 ActConsentDirective code (IMPLIED, IMPLIEDD or NOPP); the trust domain's default policy applies, normally an IHE PCF implicit policy (Volume 1 §1:53.2.1). Consent.policy names it, and the domain's published policy is the evidence (sourceAttachment). Carried in a document so that a receiver can see which policy the data was shared under.

artifacts.name: SelectiveDisclosure
artifacts.title: SelectiveDisclosure
artifacts.description:
Guidance that a document signing service with selective disclosure support (e.g. SD-JWT) should perform a selective disclosure of the content of the containing node of the extension in the JSON representation of the FHIR instance.

The code value should be from a code system containing appropriate disclosure statements for the use case.  The disclosure statement should describe the content that is to be disclosed at that node.  For example a code such as 'disclose-date-of-birth' or 'disclose-vaccine-history'.
